channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Deandre Ayton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Deandre Ayton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Khris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, Trae Young
item.description:
“A lot of No. 1 picks come into a situation where they are ‘The Guy’ (and) everything’s kind of centered around them. But I have All-Star Hall-of-Famers on my team that I can (learn) under and get some knowledge from: Khris Middleton, Trae Young, AD and Deandre Ayton. So I don’t have to come in and carry this huge load. I think I can just bond with these guys and learn it slowly and learn how to play the right way.”

AJ Dybantsa on Khris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, Trae Young, Sep 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Sengun on Ayton's ejection:

“I don't want to like make the officials crazy but I didn't expect him to be ejected. I think it was a little bit soft. I'm glad they called it”

Alperen Sengun on Deandre Ayton, Apr 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Lakers coach JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton’s Flagrant 2 and elbow to Alperen Sengun:

“DA is — he's got such a sweet, just like, kind soul. And, no, that wasn't dirty or intentional. It looked, you know, from our vantage point, like he was trying to brace himself with that off arm.”

JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Alperen Sengun, Apr 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Marcus Smart, Deandre Ayton, Luke Kennard, Jake LaRavia
item.description:
“Because this is a new group. We added [Deandre Ayton], Marcus [Smart] and Jake [LaRavia] and we just got a new acquisition on our ballclub a couple games ago [in Luke Kennard]. So, it's too hard to really say what we're capable of.”

LeBron James on Marcus Smart, Deandre Ayton, Luke Kennard, Jake LaRavia, Feb 15, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
After the Lakers’ win, head coach JJ Redick revealed that Deandre Ayton was available to return but he stayed away from his to be cautious with Jaxson Hayes and Jarred Vanderbilt playing well in his absence.

“He just had some middle back spasms. He was available in the fourth quarter when he came back out. He had a heat pack on, but I just felt that it wasn’t worth it given that group with Jaxson and Vando at the five, rotating between them in the second half, they were really good. Just didn’t want to risk it with Ayton,”

JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Jaxson Hayes, Nov 1, 2025. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Lakers President Rob Pelinka on Deandre Ayton:

“Acquiring a starting-caliber center was the top priority for us this offseason, and we believe Deandre is an amazing solution to that objective and is an ideal player to add to our current core. Deandre’s size, mobility and athleticism will allow both paint scoring and paint protection. Deandre’s playoff experience as a starter on an NBA Finals team also aligns well with our ultimate Lakers championship aspirations.”

Rob Pelinka on Deandre Ayton, Jul 6, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Chauncey Billups on Deandre Ayton:

“We’ve unlocked him. We’re getting the best version of him. He’s been a monster.”

Chauncey Billups on Deandre Ayton, Mar 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
“Deandre, from the No. 1 pick to making that finals run, there’s a lot of development and growth and Chris was big part of that at the same time. I credit those guys, Dario too.”

Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton, Nov 20, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: James Jones on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
James Jones:

“He’s just aware, self aware. I think a lot of times, our guys pay too much attention to social media and the noise I would say, but they can’t avoid it because there the ones people talk about. Deandre is extremely self aware. I think what gets lost is his desire to be great and how much winning matters to him. I’ll say it again, he’s not even 25 years old (turns 25 Tuesday) and he’s six years into his NBA career. He’s an 18 (points per game) and 10 (rebounds per game) player and if you were to ask the game’s greatest players how easy it is to do that, they’ll tell you it’s extremely difficult, but even that bar isn’t high enough for him and others.”

James Jones on Deandre Ayton, Jul 22, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Devin Booker on trying to pick up Deandre Ayton after tonight:

“Energy and effort always has to be high, especially around this time. You can’t get flustered,you can’t get in your own head, and I could see that with him a little bit tonight, so that’s my job to just pump him up”

Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton, May 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Clippers head coach Tyronn Lue noted.

“In the first half I thought we did a good job with our bigs being up. And then Ayton, he kind of got going, he made like four or five of ’em, and then we backed up. Then Book and KD and CP got going. So just mixing up our coverages, try to keep them off balance. I thought our zone was pretty good for us at times, but just got to keep trying to keep them off balance as best as possible.”

Tyronn Lue on Deandre Ayton, Apr 19, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Chris Paul, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
KD on Suns:

“You got somebody like Devin,Chris Paul & Deandre Ayton, guys that work and I wanted to be a part of that”

Kevin Durant on Chris Paul, Deandre Ayton, Feb 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Beverley said during the podcast.

“I shake everybody’s hand. I put my hand on Deandre Ayton’s hand and he don’t shake my hand. So, something was brewing there from the beginning.”

Patrick Beverley on Deandre Ayton, Dec 1, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Anthony Davis on the altercation between Pat Bev and Deandre Ayton:

“We got each other back. Pat is known for that... He did what he should do is having his teammate's back. We never gonna let anyone stand over our teammate.”

Anthony Davis on Deandre Ayton, Nov 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @_Talkin_NBA.

item.title: Zach Lowe.RealGM on Deandre Ayton, Jalen Duren
item.description:
The Detroit Pistons were linked to a potential pursuit of Deandre Ayton this offseason, but the availability of Jalen Duren at the draft is believed to have led them to change direction.

“The Ayton thing, I think they were going to be the Ayton offer sheet team until Jalen Duren fell to them at 13,”

Zach Lowe.RealGM on Deandre Ayton, Jalen Duren, Oct 12, 2022. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton:

“I'm excited for him. I know that's a weight lifted off his shoulders.”

Devin Booker on Deandre Ayton, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Brian Windhorst, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
“And next thing you know, whoever it was,Windy (ESPN’s Brian Windhorst) or somebody on the TV was like naming the potential trade targets. Naming DA (Deandre Ayton), me, Mikal (Bridges). And I was like, come on man, but it’s the business.”

Cam Johnson on Brian Windhorst, Deandre Ayton, Jul 31, 2022. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
“He went out and was a solider the whole year, played well, improved his statistics. So, we’re proud of him. A lot of guys handle things differently, but he was very mature about it. Things will work out for Deandre. He’s a valuable player. There’s other teams in the league as well. He’s a restricted free agent, so we’ll see how this process unfolds.”

Bill Duffy on Deandre Ayton, May 23, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
“(McGee) played well, he was a great addition to the team, but it all hinges on Deandre Ayton,”

Charles Barkley on Deandre Ayton, May 19, 2022. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Monty Williams on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on whether DA is a part of the Suns' long-term plans:

“Deandre's situation is something that we'll deal with this summer. I don't want to say anything in regards to that. James and I are going to have conversations about the team in general.”

Monty Williams on Deandre Ayton, May 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Kellan Olson:Mikal Bridges on Deandre Ayton knocking down a few 3s lately:

“He's a triplet, man. I told him. As soon as I gave him that nickname, that boy been hittin'.”

Mikal Bridges on Deandre Ayton, Apr 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Mikal Bridges on Deandre Ayton:

“We came here together and we obviously always want to be here together. We both want to be here and I want him here as well. Obviously I can’t do nothing, I’m not in the process, but we want him here and I know he wants to be here as well.”

Mikal Bridges on Deandre Ayton, Oct 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Javale McGee on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
With Dario Saric recovering from a knee injury suffered in the NBA Finals, McGee will play a key role as a backup five to Deandre Ayton.

“I feel like my game definitely helps Deandre Ayton in a major way just for the veteran leadership alone,”

Javale McGee on Deandre Ayton, Sep 16, 2021. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Mark Bryant on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
“Because so many times people are like, 'This guy is 7,' and I get around him, and he's really 6-10. Deandre is a legit 7.And when I saw him moving around, I said to myself, 'Oh my god, this kid is gonna be alright if he keeps working it.'”

Mark Bryant on Deandre Ayton, Jul 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Paul on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Chris Paul on Deandre Ayton's foul trouble:

“We got to protect him better, and make sure we're putting up that wall.”

Chris Paul on Deandre Ayton, Jul 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone, while correcting a reporter's pronunciation of Nikola Jokic's name, on Jokic's 7 2nd half points in Game 1:

“Deandre Ayton's a good defender so I don't know if they did anything tricky... You give them credit. I think for us, for Nikola, I think we settled way too much.”

Nikola Jokic on Deandre Ayton, Jun 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Monty Williams on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Deandre Ayton:

“I think he's done everything we've asked him to do. Defensive side of the ball, he's become an anchor for us.”

Monty Williams on Deandre Ayton, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Antonio Williams on Deandre Ayton, Trae Young, Luka Doncic
item.description:
via Basketball Network - Former Suns scout Antonio Williams on why they drafted Deandre Ayton ahead of Luka Doncic and Trae Young:

“With Deandre, one of the things was, you look at the things that he does…at his size when you combine the athleticism and the dexterity and the agility there are just things he can just roll out of bed and do. Of course, we knew Luka and Trae Young were going to be great, but when we’re looking at Deandre again, there are just things that we felt he inherently can just roll out of bed and do that we didn’t have on our roster.”

Antonio Williams on Deandre Ayton, Trae Young, Luka Doncic, Mar 8, 2021. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Chris Paul on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Chris Paul on Deandre Ayton:

“DA is full of personality. If you're around him, you can't help but to love him because of his energy and how good of a person he is.”

Chris Paul on Deandre Ayton, Mar 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on getting after Ayton:

“He has unreal talent, and it's not me getting on him, it's calling him up to the talent he has.”

Monty Williams on Deandre Ayton, Feb 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.
